history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person with dark, tousled hair and glasses is seated on a dark sofa. They are wearing a light blue hoodie with a white graphic design on the chest and grey sweatpants with white stripes down the sides. The person is leaning their head on their hand, appearing relaxed or contemplative. Next to them on the sofa is a patterned throw pillow with a geometric design in shades of grey and blue. The background features a wall with vertical, textured panels in a warm, brown tone. The lighting is soft, casting gentle shadows and creating a cozy, intimate atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by muted blues, greys, and browns, with a touch of warmth from the background. The overall mood is casual and relaxed.
